'''Chainmail leggings''' are a piece of [[chainmail armor]], crafted from 7 {{MCW|Chain|iron chains}}. Unlike in vanilla, chainmail can be crafted, and every piece carries Thorns III.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give 5 armor (up from 4 in vanilla) and have 300 durability (vanilla: 225). A full set gives 15 armor, the same as iron.

=== Enchantments ===
Thorns III is an ordinary enchantment on the item: attackers take damage, at the cost of extra durability.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

They melt down into one iron ingot in a [[blast furnace]].
